english:
Class Ability usage while within 15 meters of an enemy grants Super Ability Energy.

Super Energy Gains:
<pve 2.5% /> <pvp [1.25%] /> | <pve 4% /> <pvp [2.4%] />

Energy gains scale by class: 1x for <hunter/>Hunters, 1.2x for <titan/>Titans, and 2x for <warlock/>Warlocks.

source.text:
On Class Ability Usage while within 15 metres of an enemy:
Grants Super Ability Energy.

Super Energy Gains:
2.5% | 4%
1.25% | 2.4%

Super Energy Multipliers based on Class:
Hunters: x1 | Titans: x1.2 | Warlocks: x2
